title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Fir is a startup building travel apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Eastmere.

Our stack: swift. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and work closely with design and product.

Regular hack days. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
